newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet hit by falling gas oil futures, poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet hit by falling gas oil futures, poor demand.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums were broadly steady, but activity was very slow and outright prices were knocked lower by weaker IPE gas oil futures.
April IPE gas oil was trading down $2.50 a tonne at $172.75 at 1715 GMT.
Two jet barges with a combined volume of 5,000 tonnes were sold at April IPE +$17.50 fob ARA, although most traders described activity as fairly lacklustre.
Cargoes were assessed around April IPE +$21 cif NWE while material in the Med was around fob high jet quotes +$7 for EC spec and fob high quotes +$4-5 for Libyan quality.
